Check an LD matrix once for the BRIERs fitters

check_ld_summary.Rd

The O(nnz) LD checks of cd_summary_fit and cd_summary_fit_ssr (square, finite, symmetric), exported so that a driver can validate each LD (or each block) once, before mclapply over eta, and then call the fitters with check_ld = FALSE.

Usage

check_ld_summary(ld_mat)

Arguments

ld_mat

A p x p sparse matrix representing the linkage disequilibrium (LD) structure.

Value

Nothing; stops with an error if a check fails.
